title: Koa Health
description: Co-founded and scaled a digital mental health company from 1 to 40 people, raising €66M and reaching 3M users. Built a portfolio of clinically validated products in partnership with the NHS, Harvard, and Janssen.

sections.title: Context
sections.body: Koa Health was a digital mental health company spun out of Telefonica Alpha. I co-founded the product function and grew the product and design team from 1 to 40 people over seven years. The company raised €66M and reached 3 million users across 70+ countries. Partners included the NHS, Harvard Medical School, Massachusetts General Hospital, and Janssen / Johnson & Johnson.

sections.title: Problem
sections.body: Mental health conditions are among the most prevalent and most underserved in healthcare. The core business problem was two-sided: demonstrating clinical outcomes strong enough to satisfy NHS and pharma partners, while building a consumer product that people would actually use and retain. Cost and access were the structural barriers — qualified therapist time was expensive and scarce; most people who needed support couldn't get it in time.

sections.title: My role
sections.body: I co-founded the company and owned the full product function: vision, portfolio strategy, roadmap, team structure, OKRs, and clinical partner relationships. I was personally involved in the most critical product decisions — the crisis prediction model's clinical design, the Perspectives clinical trial structure, and the Janssen partnership scope. Day-to-day delivery across the team of 40 was managed by the team leads I hired.

sections.title: Approach
sections.body: The portfolio was built around three distinct product bets: a clinically validated DTx app (Perspectives, with MGH and Harvard), an ML-based crisis prediction service (with NHS Birmingham), and a Janssen-partnered DTx companion to Spravato for treatment-resistant depression. Across all three, the design challenge was the same: make clinically rigorous interventions work as consumer or clinical products without compromising therapeutic integrity. I introduced a company-wide innovation programme to increase velocity and reduce cost of investigation, using structured experimentation across data science, AI, design, and engineering.

sections.title: Outcome
sections.body:
• €66M investment raised
  • 3M users across 70+ countries
  • 80% recall on ML-based mental health crisis prediction (NHS, 28 days in advance)
  • 55% reduction in symptoms and 95% cost reduction in Perspectives clinical trial (vs. traditional therapy)
  • 62% increase in delivery velocity
  • 82% decrease in cost per investigation
  • 3 digital health patents filed
